notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl, WebFetch) returned 403 for both a ClaudeBot UA and a standard browser UA (WAF/bot-detection block, not a robots.txt policy opt-out - robots.txt was checked in full and names only Pinterestbot/Twitterbot/SemrushBot/AhrefsBot/MJ12bot in its 'Agressive Agent' group, no Claude-specific Disallow). No Playwright/CDP tool was available in this session besides the Claude-in-Chrome connector, so per the access-tier rules that connector was used as the working tier. Explored the live Maison mega-menu (Linge de maison, Mobilier, Luminaires, Culinaire, Arts de la table, Decoration, Electromenager et multimedia, Idees cadeaux, Tout l'univers Maison). Decoration de la maison sub-tabs: Objets de decoration, Rideaux et stores, Bougies et senteurs, Autres decorations murales, Tapis. Objets de decoration sub-tabs (full list, confirmed via page text): Objets decoratifs, Vases/cache-pots et pots de fleur, Coussins, Miroirs, Decorations festives, Cadres-photo et peles-meles, Coussins de sol, Plantes - 'Decorations festives' is the only seasonal/holiday-associated node found. Verified it is a genuine leaf PLP (no further sub-tabs) whose sampled products are exclusively Christmas items (baubles/ornaments, angel ornaments, decorative trees, reindeer figures, brand ranges 'Christmas Chic' and 'Winter Glow'), so it was classified as Christmas / Festive Decorations. Also checked Art de la table (Vaisselle, Accessoires de table, Cuisine nomade, Vins et cocktails), Luminaires (Luminaires interieur, Ampoules, Luminaires exterieur), and Linge de maison (Linge de lit/bain/table/decoration, Couettes et oreillers) - no seasonal-specific sub-categories in any of them. Ran site-search discrimination checks scoped to the Maison et loisirs facet: 'Noel' returned 120 results (a discriminating, non-catch-all number, roughly consistent with but not identical to the 142-count category page, so the category page's own displayed total was used as the canonical qty rather than the search count), 'Halloween' returned only a handful of incidental non-category matches (e.g. a Swarovski figurine merely named 'Halloween', a Lagostina cookware line), 'Paques' (Easter) and 'Saint-Valentin' each returned 0 results within Maison. Combined with no corresponding nav/category node for any of those occasions, Halloween/Easter/Valentine's Day/other holidays are treated as absent from the Maison taxonomy (search alone was not relied on as sole proof - it was cross-checked against the real navigation tree, which also shows no such nodes). The site's category sitemap (siteMap/Category-fr-EUR.xml) was also checked for a 'noel' slug and found none, but that sitemap file appeared to only enumerate Homme/Femme/Enfant/Beaute category URLs (no 'maison' entries at all), so it was treated as inconclusive/weak evidence and not relied upon. No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow exists, so this is not a policy_opt_out.
